core_business: Bank of Asia CJSC is a universal commercial bank offering a full range of banking services: lending to legal entities and individuals, cash and settlement services, foreign exchange operations, payment cards (Elkart, international systems), deposits, money transfers, bank guarantees, salary projects, safe deposit boxes, and digital banking through its Asia Online mobile platform. The bank is registered as a subject of the Bishkek Free Economic Zone and was established with 100% foreign capital participation.
apec_stance: As a Kyrgyz commercial bank with 100% foreign capital foundation and Bishkek Free Economic Zone registration, Bank of Asia is positioned as a cross-border trade finance and international remittance enabler. Its correspondent banking network and foreign exchange operations support Kyrgyzstan's growing trade and labor-migration flows with APEC economies including China (cross-border yuan settlement), Russia (rouble remittances), South Korea (Korean shareholder/director presence, Lee Jong Baek on BoD), and Türkiye. The bank actively develops digital infrastructure (Asia Online app with multi-language RU/EN/KG support) to facilitate international transactions. Kyrgyzstan became an APEC member in 1998 (the bank's founding year), aligning the institution's trajectory with the country's broader Asia-Pacific economic integration.
profile: Bank of Asia CJSC (ЗАО «Банк Азии», Азия Банкы) is a Bishkek-based commercial bank founded on 10 February 1998 with banking license No. 042 (originally No. 42) issued by the National Bank of the Kyrgyz Republic on 17 November 1998 (re-issued 22 June 2017). It was one of the first banks in Kyrgyzstan established with 100% foreign capital participation and is registered as a subject of the Bishkek Free Economic Zone. Headquartered at 720016, Kyrgyz Republic, Bishkek, 132a Kievskaya Street (with operations at 303/4 Aitmatov Avenue), the bank ranks among the top 15 Kyrgyz banks by assets (approximately KGS 9 billion as of December 2024). The bank operates a network of branches and ATMs across Bishkek and offers digital banking through its proprietary Asia Online platform. The Beishenalieva family controls the bank, with Nazira Beishenalieva serving as Chairperson of the Board of Directors. The Board includes international representation (Lee Jong Baek of Korean origin), reflecting the bank's foreign-capital heritage. In 2025, the bank increased its authorized capital to KGS 1.3 billion and was awarded 'Best Taxpayer of 2025' by the Kyrgyz State Tax Service for FEZ entities.
